name: AI Comment Moderation
description: Moderates Drupal comments with OpenAI's Moderation API — unpublishes comments the API flags as inappropriate.
project_description: AI Comment Moderation sends each comment's body to OpenAI's Moderation API (https://api.openai.com/v1/moderations) on comment presave; if the API flags the text as inappropriate the comment is set unpublished and the author sees a warning message. It ships a single admin settings form for the OpenAI API key and a service that wraps the API call. Requires the core comment module and an OpenAI API key. Comment text is sent to OpenAI for classification.
